segments.md:
# Vortex

Atari's Tempest (1981), written afresh as a Declare program rather than ported:
it plays the same game, without chasing the arcade frame by frame (the faithful
port is `../tempest/`). Keyboard only. You are the claw on the rim of a tube;
enemies climb from the far end; shoot them down the lanes, clear the wave,
and fly down the tube to the next one. Its waves are the arcade's: how many
enemies, which kinds and how many at once, how they move, how fast they climb
and fire, and when they come up (waves.json, the arcade's own table).

How it is put together:

- `model.declare` — the records (`schema`s), the tube's geometry (`Tube`, a
  class on the current shape record) and the field of play (`Playfield`, the
  dataset of everything in the tube, with its rules).
- `sprites.declare` — the tube drawing and the sprites: one class per kind of
  enemy, each placed by constraints over its record and the game clock.
- `screens.declare` — the colors per sixteen levels (theme records), the score
  panel, the attract screen, "rate yourself", and the cards.
- `sound.declare` — the arcade's sounds on its eight voices.
- this file — the helpers, the fixed data (tube shapes, starting levels, keys,
  stars; the waves from waves.json), and the App: where the player is (mode, level,
  score, lives, the claw), the clocks that drive play, the keyboard, and the
  tree of views.

A game goes: the attract screen (and now and then a demo) → "rate yourself",
choosing where to start → each level: the fall through the stars as its tube
arrives, play, and the dive down the tube when the wave is cleared → game over.

Controls: ← → or A S spin · Space or Return fire · ↓ or Z superzap ·
Escape pause (any key goes on) · M sound on or off · Return start.

*This program is new code, written in Declare. It recreates the play of Tempest, Atari's
1981 arcade game, whose original program was written in 6502 assembly language, and uses
that game's sounds. Tempest, its name, artwork, sounds and visual design belong to Atari,
Inc. or its successors; they are used here only to illustrate and test the Declare language,
and no claim is made to them. The MIT license of this repository covers this code, not the
original game's name, artwork or sounds. If you hold rights in this material and object to
its being posted here, please open an issue on this repository on GitHub, or message me
there, and I will remove it.*

segments.html:
include [ "model.declare" ]

include [ "sprites.declare" ]

include [ "screens.declare" ]

include [ "sound.declare" ]

include [ "../touch-pad.declare" ]

defaultFlags [ render = canvas, accessibility = false ]

// helpers: plain functions of their arguments (numbers, lanes, angles, colors, the vector pen)

script {
    type Kind = "flipper" | "tanker" | "spiker" | "fuseball" | "pulsar"

    // the fields a move of an enemy writes, each with its new value
    type Moves = [string, number][]

    function lerp(a: number, b: number, t: number): number { return a + (b - a) * t }
    function clamp(v: number, lo: number, hi: number): number { return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v)) }
    function mod(v: number, n: number): number { return ((v % n) + n) % n }
    function rnd(n: number): number { return Math.floor(Math.random() * n) }
    function fract(v: number): number { return v - Math.floor(v) }

    // a fixed pseudo-random number in [0, 1) for a pair of integers: the same
    // every time it is asked, so data built from it never changes
    function hash(i: number, k: number): number { return fract(Math.sin(i * 127.1 + k * 311.7) * 43758.5453) }

    // the signed step from one lane to another: the short way round a closed
    // tube, straight across an open one
    function laneStep(from: number, to: number, closed: boolean): number {
        const d = to - from
        return closed ? mod(d + 8, 16) - 8 : d
    }

    // the signed turn from one angle to another, the short way (degrees)
    function turnBetween(a: number, b: number): number { return mod(b - a + 180, 360) - 180 }

    // blend two 0xRRGGBB colors channel-wise
    function mix(a: number, b: number, t: number): number {
        const c = (x: number, y: number) => Math.round(x + (y - x) * t)
        return (c((a >> 16) & 255, (b >> 16) & 255) << 16) | (c((a >> 8) & 255, (b >> 8) & 255) << 8) | c(a & 255, b & 255)
    }

    // a glowing vector pen: the arcade's look, set once per stroke
    function glowPen(d: DrawContext, ink: number, width: number) {
        d.strokeStyle = ink
        d.shadowColor = ink
        d.shadowBlur = 7
        d.lineWidth = width * 0.5
        d.lineCap = "round"
        d.lineJoin = "round"
    }
    }


App [ appName = "Vortex", fontFamily = ["Menlo", "Consolas", "monospace"],

segments.md:
## Color
The level shown picks the colors (a new set every sixteen levels); the
theme is the dark preset with that set laid over it. The App's own fill
is black, flashing toward the claw's color for the superzapper and a
bonus life.

segments.html:
paletteFor(level: number) -> object { return [Blue, Red, Yellow, Cyan, Unseen, Green][mod(Math.floor((level - 1) / 16), 6)] },
    palette: object = { app.paletteFor(app.shownLevel) },
    theme = { { ...SanFranciscoDark, ...app.palette } },
    flash: number = 0,
    fill = { mix(0x000000, app.palette.claw, app.flash * 0.4) },

mode: "attract" | "choose" | "warp" | "play" | "zoom" | "dying" | "over" = "attract",
    demo: boolean = false,         // the attract mode's game, played by the pilot
    paused: boolean = false,
    quiet: boolean = false,        // the player turned the sound off
    level: number = 1,
    reached: number = 1,           // the furthest level reached: how far "rate yourself" offers
    score: number = 0,
    lives: number = 3,
    zaps: number = 2,              // superzapper uses left this level
    startBonus: number = 0,        // earned when the first level is cleared
    showcase: number = 0,          // the tube the attract screen is showing

    // The game clock, in seconds. It runs only while there is play to watch,
    // so pausing it pauses everything that is a function of it.

    t: number = 0,
    levelStart: number = 0,
    fallStart: number = 0,
    bonusLifeAt: number = -10,

    // The claw: `clawSpot` is the lane it is going to, not wrapped, so the
    // spring that carries `clawShown` there can cross a closed tube's seam
    // the short way. `lane` is the whole lane it is in.

    clawSpot: number = 0,
    clawShown: number = 0,
    clawSpring: Spring [ attribute = clawShown, to = { app.clawSpot }, stiffness = 900, damping = 50 ],
    lane: number = { mod(app.clawSpot, 16) },
    clawLane: number = { app.tube.closed ? mod(app.clawShown, 16) : app.clawShown },
    clawDepth: number = { 1 - app.dive },

    // held keys repeat: these carry the part of a step not yet taken

    spinCarry: number = 0,
    fireCarry: number = 0,

// The level whose tube and colors are on the screen: the game's, the
    // choice being made, or the attract screen's showcase, which runs through
    // the shapes and the color sets (all but the unseen one).

    shownLevel: number = {
        app.mode == "attract" ? 1 + mod(app.showcase, 16) + 16 * [0, 1, 2, 3, 5][mod(app.showcase, 5)]
      : app.mode == "choose" ? (app.choices.value.list[app.choice]?.level ?? 1)
      : app.level },
    shapeIndex: number = { mod(app.shownLevel - 1, 16) },
    wave: Wave = { app.waveFor(app.level) },
    spares: Dataset [ contents = { { lives: Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, app.lives - 1) }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1 })) } } ],
    playing: boolean = { app.mode == "play" || app.mode == "zoom" },

    // the best score of the games played since the page opened

    best: number = 0,
    hiScore: number = { Math.max(app.best, app.demo ? 0 : app.score) },

    // things that cross into a new state, and the one action each calls for:
    // the wave is cleared (the dive begins), the chooser's clock reaches three
    // (the countdown sounds), the pulse comes on or goes off (its sound)

    cleared: boolean = { app.mode == "play" && app.field.value.nymphs.length == 0 && app.field.value.foes.length == 0 },
    secondsLeft: number = { Math.ceil(app.chooseLeft) },
    pulseLive: boolean = { app.mode == "play" && app.pulsars.value.list.length > 0 && app.field.pulseAt(app.t) },
    trackChanges = ["cleared", "secondsLeft", "pulseLive"],
    onChange(e: ChangeEvent) {
        for (const c of e.changed) {
            if (c.name == "cleared" && app.cleared) app.startDive()
            if (c.name == "secondsLeft" && app.mode == "choose" && app.secondsLeft == 3) app.cue("countdown")
            if (c.name == "pulseLive") app.cue(app.pulseLive ? "pulseOn" : "pulseOff")
            }
        },

    banner: string = { app.bannerNow() },
    bannerNow() -> string {
        if (app.mode == "zoom" && app.field.anySpikes()) return "AVOID SPIKES"
        if (app.t - app.bonusLifeAt < 2) return "BONUS LIFE"
        if (app.mode == "warp" || (app.mode == "play" && app.t - app.levelStart < 4)) return "LEVEL " + app.level
        return ""
        },
    subBanner: string = {
        !app.banner.startsWith("LEVEL") ? ""
      : app.startBonus > 0 ? "BONUS " + app.startBonus + " FOR CLEARING IT"
      : "SUPERZAPPER RECHARGE" },

    waveFor(level: number) -> Wave {
        const rows = this.waves.value?.levels ?? []
        const row = rows[level <= rows.length ? level - 1 : 64 + Math.floor(hash(level, 7) * 32)]
        return row ?? ({ level: 0, enemies: 0, plan: "climb", speed: 0, spikerSpeed: 0, shotSpeed: 0,
            flippers: { min: 0, max: 0 }, pulsars: { min: 0, max: 0 }, tankers: { min: 0, max: 0 }, spikers: { min: 0, max: 0 },
            fuseballs: { min: 0, max: 0 }, cargo: [], shots: 0, fireDelay: 0, pulsarsFire: false, spikes: 0, rimFlip: 0,
            fuseballsChase: false })
        },

segments.md:
## Choosing where to start
The levels unlocked so far (up to the furthest reached, and at least the
first five choices); the choice, and a spring that slides the strip to
it; a ten-second clock that runs whenever the chooser is shown and, run
out, starts the game at the choice.

segments.html:
choices: Dataset [ schema = [ list[]: Start ],
        contents = { { list: app.starts.value.list.filter((s) => s.level <= Math.max(9, app.reached)) } } ],
    choice: number = 0,
    choiceShown: number = 0,
    choiceSpring: Spring [ attribute = choiceShown, to = { app.choice }, stiffness = 260, damping = 26 ],
    chooseLeft: number = 10,
    chooseClock: Animator [ attribute = chooseLeft, from = 10, to = 0, duration = 10000, motion = linear,
        started = { app.mode == "choose" }, paused = { app.paused },
        onStop() { if (app.mode == "choose") app.pick() }
        ],

segments.md:
## The camera
`dive` carries the claw (and the eye) down the tube at the end of a
level; `approach` brings each new tube in from the distance while the
claw falls through the stars. Both are timed runs, so Animators: the dive
starts itself whenever the mode becomes "zoom", and its end begins the
next level; the approach's end begins play.

segments.html:
dive: number = 0,
    approach: number = 0,
    cam: number = { app.dive * (app.tube.zFar - 1) - app.approach },
    diving: Animator [ attribute = dive, from = 0, to = 1, duration = 2600, motion = quadIn,
        started = { app.mode == "zoom" }, paused = { app.paused },
        onStop() { if (app.mode == "zoom") app.levelDone() }
        ],
    arriving: Animator [ attribute = approach, from = 16, to = 0, duration = 2600, motion = cubicOut,
        paused = { app.paused },
        onStop() { if (app.mode == "warp") app.mode = "play" }
        ],
    starsShown: number = { app.mode == "warp" ? clamp(app.approach / 5, 0, 1) : 0 },
    zapFlash: Animator [ attribute = flash, from = 1, to = 0, duration = 700, motion = quadOut ],

tube: Tube [ datapath = { app.tubes.value.shapes[app.shapeIndex] },
        cx = { app.width / 2 },
        cy = { app.height / 2 + 30 },
        radius = { Math.min(app.width * 0.42, (app.height - 120) * 0.5) },
        cam = { app.cam } ],
    field: Playfield [ foeShotSpeed = { app.wave.shotSpeed } ] { { "nymphs": [], "foes": [], "shots": [], "foeShots": [], "spikes": [], "blasts": [] } },

    // the pulsars, to light their lanes: a derived dataset holding the field's own records

    pulsars: Dataset [ contents = { { list: app.field.value.foes.filter((f) => f.kind == "pulsar") } } ],

board: SoundBoard [ quiet = { app.quiet || app.paused } ],
    cue(name: string) { if (!demo && mode != "attract") board.cue(name) },

segments.md:
## Clocks
One per frame, for what depends on the frame before: the game clock, held
keys, and the step of play. The rest are beats: the enemies' decisions,
the demo's pilot, the attract screen's next tube.

segments.html:
frame: Time [ tick = frame, running = { (app.mode == "warp" || app.playing || app.mode == "dying") && !app.paused },
        onTick(dt: number) { app.advance(dt) }
        ],
    brain: Time [ tick = 250, running = { app.mode == "play" && !app.paused },
        onTick() { app.field.think(app.t, app.lane, app.tube.closed, app.wave) }
        ],
    pilot: Time [ tick = 70, running = { app.demo && app.playing },
        onTick() { app.steer() }
        ],
    carousel: Time [ tick = 3500, running = { app.mode == "attract" },
        onTick() {
            app.showcase = app.showcase + 1
            if (mod(app.showcase, 4) == 0) app.startDemo()
            else app.arriving.start()
            }
        ],

segments.md:
## The keyboard
Discrete keys arrive as events; held keys (spin, fire) are read in the
frame step with `Keys.isDown`.

segments.html:
keys: Keys [ onKeyDown(e: KeyEvent) { if (!e.repeat) app.press(e.code) }
        ],

    press(code: string) {
        const start = code == "Enter" || code == "NumpadEnter"
        const fireKey = start || code == "Space"
        const left = code == "ArrowLeft" || code == "KeyA", right = code == "ArrowRight" || code == "KeyS"
        if (code == "KeyM") { quiet = !quiet; return }
        if (code == "Escape") { if (!demo && mode != "attract" && mode != "over") paused = !paused; return }
        if (paused) { paused = false; return }
        if (mode == "attract" || mode == "over" || demo) { if (start) { if (demo) endDemo(); choose() } return }
        if (mode == "choose") {
            if (left || right) {
                const to = clamp(choice + (right ? 1 : -1), 0, choices.value.list.length - 1)
                if (to != choice) { choice = to; cue("click") }
                }
            else if (fireKey) pick()
            return
            }
        if (!playing) return
        if (left) { spin(-1); spinCarry = -0.25 }
        else if (right) { spin(1); spinCarry = -0.25 }
        else if (fireKey) { fire(); fireCarry = 0 }
        else if ((code == "ArrowDown" || code == "KeyZ") && mode == "play") superzap()
        },

    held(codes: string[]) -> boolean { return codes.some((c) => Keys.isDown(c)) },

advance(dt: number) {
        t = t + dt
        if (playing && !demo) {
            const dir = (held(["ArrowRight", "KeyS"]) || pad.isDown("right") ? 1 : 0) - (held(["ArrowLeft", "KeyA"]) || pad.isDown("left") ? 1 : 0)
            if (dir == 0) spinCarry = 0
            else {
                spinCarry = spinCarry + dt * 11
                while (spinCarry >= 1) { spin(dir); spinCarry = spinCarry - 1 }
                }
            if (held(["Space", "Enter"]) || pad.isDown("fire")) {
                fireCarry = fireCarry + dt
                if (fireCarry >= 0.13) { fire(); fireCarry = 0 }
                }
            }
        const out = field.step(t, dt, lane, clawDepth, tube.closed, playing, wave)
        addScore(out.points)
        for (const s of out.sounds) cue(s)
        if (out.caught) die()
        else if (demo && t - levelStart > 45) endDemo()
        },

    spin(dir: number) {
        const to = tube.closed ? clawSpot + dir : clamp(clawSpot + dir, 0, 15)
        if (to != clawSpot) { clawSpot = to; cue("click") }
        },
    fire() { if (field.fire(lane, clawDepth, t)) cue("fire") },
    superzap() {
        if (zaps <= 0) return
        addScore(field.zap(zaps == 2, t))
        zaps = zaps - 1
        zapFlash.start()
        cue("explosion")
        },

    // Points; every 20,000 brings another life, up to six.

    addScore(points: number) {
        if (points == 0) return
        const before = score
        score = score + points
        if (!demo && Math.floor(score / 20000) > Math.floor(before / 20000) && lives < 6) {
            lives = lives + 1
            bonusLifeAt = t
            zapFlash.start()
            cue("bonus")
            }
        },

choose() {
        choice = clamp(choice, 0, choices.value.list.length - 1)
        choiceSpring.arrive()
        mode = "choose"
        },
    pick() {
        const s = choices.value.list[choice]
        startGame(s.level, s.bonus, false)
        },
    startGame(from: number, bonus: number, isDemo: boolean) {
        demo = isDemo
        score = 0
        lives = isDemo ? 1 : 3
        level = from
        startBonus = bonus
        t = 0
        paused = false
        board.stopAll()
        enterLevel(from)
        },

    // A level begins with the fall through the stars as its tube arrives; its
    // nymphs are laid at the far end, to rise once play begins, and some waves
    // start with spikes already standing.

    enterLevel(n: number) {
        field.reset()
        const w = waveFor(n)
        field.lay(w.enemies)
        if (w.spikes > 0) field.standSpikes(w.spikes)
        zaps = 2
        dive = 0
        levelStart = t
        fallStart = t
        reached = Math.max(reached, demo ? 1 : n)
        clawSpot = tubes.value.shapes[mod(n - 1, 16)].closed ? 0 : 7
        clawSpring.arrive()
        arriving.start()
        mode = "warp"
        },
    startDive() { mode = "zoom"; cue("fallTube") },
    levelDone() {
        cue("fallSpace")
        if (startBonus > 0) { addScore(startBonus); startBonus = 0; cue("bonus") }
        level = level + 1
        enterLevel(level)
        },
    die() {
        const fromDive = mode == "zoom"
        mode = "dying"
        lives = lives - 1
        field.blast("big", lane, clawDepth, t, 0)
        field.recall()
        cue("death")
        afterDelay(2000, () => app.afterDeath(fromDive))
        },
    afterDeath(fromDive: boolean) {
        if (demo) { endDemo(); return }
        if (lives <= 0) { gameOver(); return }
        board.hush()
        if (fromDive) { level = level + 1; enterLevel(level) }
        else mode = "play"
        },
    gameOver() {
        mode = "over"
        best = Math.max(best, score)
        afterDelay(7000, () => { if (app.mode == "over") app.mode = "attract" })
        },

segments.md:
## The demo
Now and then the attract screen plays a game itself: one life, a level
from the first few, steered by a pilot that aims at whatever is nearest
the rim. It makes no sound, and Return ends it and opens "rate
yourself".

segments.html:
startDemo() { startGame(1 + 2 * rnd(4), 0, true) },
    endDemo() {
        demo = false
        field.reset()
        mode = "attract"
        arriving.start()
        },

    // The pilot: superzap anything about to reach the claw; otherwise go for
    // the enemy nearest the rim that is still climbing (never into a lane
    // where one already waits at the rim), and fire when lined up. In the
    // dive, step out of a lane with a spike.

    steer() {
        const v = field.value
        const depth = (f: Foe) => field.depthOf(f, t)
        const near = (f: Foe) => Math.abs(laneStep(lane, field.laneNow(f, t), tube.closed)) <= 1
        if (mode == "play" && zaps > 0 && v.foes.some((f) => depth(f) >= 0.9 && near(f) && f.kind != "spiker")) { superzap(); return }
        const climbing = v.foes.filter((f) => depth(f) < 0.9 && f.kind != "spiker").sort((a, b) => depth(b) - depth(a))
        let target = climbing.length > 0 ? field.laneNow(climbing[0], t) : lane
        if (mode == "zoom" && v.spikes.some((s) => s.lane == lane && field.spikeHeight(s, t) > clawDepth - 0.4)) target = lane + 1
        const dir = target == lane ? 0 : Math.sign(laneStep(lane, target, tube.closed)) || 1
        const blocked = v.foes.some((f) => depth(f) >= 0.9 && field.laneNow(f, t) == mod(lane + dir, 16))
        if (dir != 0 && !blocked) spin(dir)
        if (v.foes.some((f) => field.laneNow(f, t) == lane) || v.spikes.some((s) => s.lane == lane && s.h > 0)) fire()
        },

segments.md:
## The screen
Declaration order is stacking order: the stars, the tube, the nymphs, the
lit lanes, the spikes, the enemies, the shots, the claw, the blasts; then
the panel, the screens, the cards and the touch pad over all of it.

segments.html:
stage: View [ width = 100%, height = 100%, clip = true,
        opacity = { app.mode == "attract" ? 0.5 : app.mode == "choose" ? 0.3 : 1 },

        starField: View [ width = 100%, height = 100%, visible = { app.starsShown > 0 }, datapath = { app.stars.value },
            StarView [ datapath = :list[] ]
            ],
        web: Web [ lit = { app.playing || app.mode == "warp" ? app.lane : -1 } ],
        nymphs: View [ width = 100%, height = 100%, datapath = { app.field.value },
            NymphView [ datapath = :nymphs[] ]
            ],
        lanes: View [ width = 100%, height = 100%, datapath = { app.pulsars.value },
            PulseBeam [ datapath = :list[] ]
            ],
        spikes: View [ width = 100%, height = 100%, datapath = { app.field.value },
            SpikeView [ datapath = :spikes[] ]
            ],
        foes: View [ width = 100%, height = 100%, datapath = { app.field.value },
            FoeView [ datapath = :foes[],
                classFor = { ({ flipper: Flipper, tanker: Tanker, spiker: Spiker, fuseball: Fuseball })[:kind] ?? Pulsar } ]
            ],
        shots: View [ width = 100%, height = 100%, datapath = { app.field.value },
            ShotView [ datapath = :shots[] ]
            ],
        foeShots: View [ width = 100%, height = 100%, datapath = { app.field.value },
            FoeShotView [ datapath = :foeShots[] ]
            ],
        claw: Claw [ visible = { app.playing || app.mode == "warp" } ],
        blasts: View [ width = 100%, height = 100%, datapath = { app.field.value },
            Remains [ datapath = :blasts[], classFor = { :kind == "points" ? PointsPop : Burst } ]
            ]
        ],

    hud: Hud [ visible = { app.mode != "attract" && app.mode != "choose" } ],

    title: TitleScreen [ visible = { app.mode == "attract" } ],

    chooser: ChooseScreen [ visible = { app.mode == "choose" } ],

    bannerCard: Notice [ y = { app.height * 0.62 }, visible = { app.banner != "" && !app.demo },
        Headline [ fontSize = 26, text = { app.banner } ],
        Subline [ visible = { app.subBanner != "" }, text = { app.subBanner } ]
        ],

    demoCard: Notice [ y = { app.height - 110 }, visible = { app.demo },
        Headline [ fontSize = 20, text = "DEMO" ],
        Subline [ text = { app.touchFirst ? "PRESS START TO PLAY" : "PRESS RETURN TO PLAY" } ]
        ],

    pauseCard: Notice [ visible = { app.paused },
        Headline [ text = "PAUSED" ],
        Subline [ text = "PRESS ANY KEY TO GO ON" ]
        ],

    overCard: Notice [ visible = { app.mode == "over" },
        Headline [ fontSize = 56, text = "GAME OVER" ],
        Subline [ text = { "SCORE " + app.score + "   ·   LEVEL " + app.level } ],
        Subline [ text = { app.touchFirst ? "START TO PLAY AGAIN" : "RETURN TO PLAY AGAIN" } ]
        ],

    // On a touch screen, Tempest's controls as its panel has them: spin under the left hand,
    // superzapper and fire under the right (../touch-pad.declare). A button newly pressed is
    // the press of its key; spin and fire held are read in the frame step.

    pad: TouchPad [ startShown = { app.mode == "attract" || app.mode == "over" || app.demo },
        ink = { provided("theme").claw },
        fieldX = { app.tube.cx - app.tube.radius }, fieldY = { app.tube.cy - app.tube.radius },
        fieldW = { 2 * app.tube.radius }, fieldH = { 2 * app.tube.radius },
